text:
HTTP::response
Description
Returns the raw HTTP response header block as a single string.
Syntax
HTTP
::
response
Examples
when
HTTP_RESPONSE
{
# Send response header block to high speed logging
HSL
::
send
$hsl
[
HTTP
::
response
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_RESPONSE
,
HTTP_RESPONSE_CONTINUE
,
HTTP_RESPONSE_DATA
,
NAME_RESOLVED
